lines.en: One tailbeat and the water surges back.

lines.zh: 钝吻破开水面，慢慢压过去。
lines.en: My blunt snout splits the surface, pressing on.
My grey back slides just over the sand.

lines.zh: 我绕着礁盘一圈，不着急。
lines.en: I circle the reef shelf, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 水流撞上我的宽头，分开。
lines.en: Water hits my broad head and divides.

lines.zh: 我从深处往上抬，影子先到。
lines.en: I rise from the deep; my shadow arrives first.
My tail lifts a whole cloud of sand.
I turn in half a body length.
Warm water pushes and I ride along.

lines.zh: 前面是浅滩，我压低身子。
lines.en: Shallows ahead; I keep low.

lines.zh: 我游过海草，草全伏下去。
lines.en: I pass the seagrass and it all bends down.
My grey shadow drags long behind me.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的船底游过去。
lines.en: I glide under the hull of your boat.
This stretch of sea, I know it well.

lines.zh: 我侧着身，用半片眼睛看你。
lines.en: I turn sideways and keep half an eye on you.
Against the current, I beat my tail harder.

lines.zh: 我从礁石缝里挤过去，不掉速。
lines.en: I squeeze through a gap in the reef without slowing.
A strand of weed snags me. I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我悬在中层水里，背鳍不动。
lines.en: I hang mid-water, my dorsal fin still.
My broad head faces the incoming flow.

lines.zh: 鳃一开一合，水从两边走。
lines.en: My gills open and shut, water passing both sides.
I stay still, and the school dares not move.

lines.zh: 阳光从水面漏下来，很碎。
lines.en: Sunlight leaks down through the surface in pieces.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水把气味带来。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to bring a scent.
A trace of blood far off; I note it.
An old scar on my back shows pale.
I turn slowly and come back around.
Warm water like this feels like home.

lines.zh: 我的影子压在沙上，很沉。
lines.en: My shadow lies heavy on the sand.

lines.zh: 有小鱼贴着我游，我不理。
lines.en: Little fish swim against me; I ignore them.
Sea water fills my mouth; no taste.

lines.zh: 我一整天都能这么悬着。
lines.en: I can hang like this all day.

lines.zh: 你下水了，我立刻转过来。
lines.en: You enter the water and I turn at once.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，先看你的腿。
lines.en: I circle you, starting with your legs.
You slap the water; I know that sound.

lines.zh: 你的心跳从水里传过来。
lines.en: Your heartbeat travels through the water.
I stop twenty feet away and watch you.
You back away and I follow slowly.
Your spear is raised too high.

lines.zh: 我在你脚下游过，你没看见。
lines.en: I pass beneath your feet unseen.
The blood smell on you is faint.
You hold your breath while I circle and watch.
One hit and I spin around at once.
Blood clouds the water, and it's mine.
Whoever struck me, I remember.
The hide is cut, but not deep.
I whip my tail and withdraw twenty feet.
That blow only makes me angrier.
It burns beside my gills.
I loop around and return from the side.
Thirty points of health; I can afford this.
I don't flee; I only change direction.
That fish in your hand, I don't need it.
That bait wouldn't fill one bite.
It's you I smell, not the fish.

lines.zh: 你把食物丢远，我偏不去。
lines.en: You throw the food far; I won't go.

lines.zh: 诱饵晃来晃去，像条伤鱼。
lines.en: The lure wiggles like a wounded fish.
I've taken too many hooks already.
Your hand smells better than the food.

lines.zh: 我不吃小东西，只吃大的。
lines.en: I don't eat small things; only big ones.
That chunk of meat drops and I take it.
One bite, and your hand is part of it.
You ram me like a reef wall.
My hide feels like rough stone.
I shoulder you back half a step.
We collide in a churn of water.
My broad head is hard; don't meet it head-on.
You grab my back and I throw you off.
After the hit I loop and come back.
Our struggle muddies the water.
My tail rakes across your waist.

lines.zh: 你贴着我，能听见我鳃响。
lines.en: Pressed against me, you hear my gills work.
In the warm season I follow her.
We turn side by side in the shallows.
I rub her flank with my snout.
She carries a few old bite marks.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后，绕过礁石。
lines.en: We round the reef, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 水暖了，我们就凑在一起。
lines.en: The water warms and we come together.

lines.zh: 小鲨鱼在更浅的地方出生。
lines.en: The young are born in shallower water.

lines.zh: 她游开，我隔着一段跟着。
lines.en: She leaves; I trail a little behind her.

lines.zh: 这一片水域养得起我们。
lines.en: These waters can feed us both.
Our tails touch once, then part.
You dropped something; I saw it.

lines.zh: 我用吻顶了顶那只木箱。
lines.en: I nudge the wooden crate with my snout.
Iron sinks fast in water.
I take the rope end, then let go.

lines.zh: 牙是为肉长的，不是为这个。
lines.en: My teeth are for meat, not this.

lines.zh: 那东西碰我的牙，响了一声。
lines.en: It clinks against my teeth.
I shove it into a sand trench.

lines.zh: 沉船的木板我早看腻了。
lines.en: Wreck planks bore me by now.
I circle it without eating.
I bite once. Wood. I spit.
I smell blood and my heading is set.
That mid-sized fish swims too slow.
Its tail fin is missing a piece.

lines.zh: 我从它背后来，不打招呼。
lines.en: I come from behind, without warning.

lines.zh: 水里那点扑腾就是信号。
lines.en: That thrashing in the water is the signal.
I lock onto the small shark.
It's smaller than me and turns clumsily.
I lower my head and aim at its flank.
You swim far worse than the fish.
In this sea, I decide.

lines.zh: 我贴着它下面，等它转身。
lines.en: I stay beneath it, waiting for the turn.
It veers, and I cut across.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在侧面，看得清。
lines.en: My eyes sit on the sides; I see clearly.
Three body lengths to go.
I close my gills and charge.
It starts to panic. Good.

lines.zh: 我绕到它背后，水声盖住我。
lines.en: I slip behind it; the water hides me.

lines.zh: 它往礁石缝里钻，我先到。
lines.en: It dives for a crack; I get there first.
I just wait for it to tire.
That shadow on the surface is me.
My teeth sink deep into its flank.
My teeth close and the water reddens.
The impact rolls it over.

lines.zh: 我一扭头，连皮带肉扯下。
lines.en: I twist my head and tear away skin and meat.
Eight points of damage; it will remember.

lines.zh: 我的吻顶得它退不出水。
lines.en: My snout pins it against the shallows.
It struggles, so I bite harder.

lines.zh: 尾巴一拍，把它压向沙底。
lines.en: A tail slap drives it to the bottom.
Only when I let go does it flee.
The blood spreads; I circle back.

lines.zh: 温水里多了我这道灰影。
lines.en: The warm water gains my grey shape.

lines.zh: 我从深处升上来，绕一圈。
lines.en: I rise from the deep and circle once.

lines.zh: 这片海一次来我一两条。
lines.en: These waters get one or two of me.
The egg splits and I bite the water first.
I was born with teeth.
A warm current carries me to the shallows.
Beyond the reef shelf, I found my route.
I arrived half a day before my kin.
That light on the surface, I know it.
Plenty of fish here; I'll stay.
The surface burns and I sink away.
Flung ashore, I slap the sand.
In air, my gills cannot close.
The blast rolls me over.
An arrow buries itself in my back.
Something pulls at my gills.
Days without food thin my sides.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我全身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning in the water locks my body.
The water ends and I drop into black.
